name: ui.image.set_source
evidence: Code at 0x1c06ceb4 preserves R0 as image object and R1 as source, classifies the source and loads metadata; strings identify lv_image_set_src. Firmware veneer 0x0c587fa0 branches to this entry. The first eight bytes are PUSH.W, MOV and SUB SP and can be copied by the current Thumb planner.
lifetime: Source may point to a descriptor or to a file/symbol string; ownership varies by source type and callers must supply a valid source for its required lifetime.
scope: global, no callsite or object filter; quiescence of all threads using the target is required when patching and restoring
